2610.13693.title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
2610.13693.paper_summary: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. Although our framework supports calibrators ranging from temperature and matrix scaling to NN layers, our results show that using the final classification layer itself as the calibrator yields accurate, well-calibrated models with no additional parameters. Our approach outperforms SOTA calibrators with minimal added complexity, while also avoiding the multiplicative overhead of separate calibration components in settings such as multi-task learning.
2610.13693.paper_summary_zh: 神經網絡（NNs）雖然高度靈活且多功能，但通常校準不佳。事後校準方法使用單獨的校準數據集和額外的校準參數來調整已訓練模型的輸出。這一過程增加了開銷，要求對校準器進行單獨的優化和隨後的模型選擇。在本文中，我們展示了標準（事後）校準器可以通過雙層斯塔克爾伯格（Stackelberg）公式與主幹進行端到端訓練。這一公式通過使用交叉熵共同優化準確性和校準，消除了對單獨校準集或專用校準損失的需求，只引入了一個額外的超參數：校準器學習率。儘管我們的框架支持從溫度和矩陣縮放到神經網絡層的校準器，但我們的結果顯示，將最終分類層本身用作校準器可以產生準確且良好校準的模型，且無需額外參數。我們的方法在增加的複雜性最小的情況下超越了最先進的校準器，同時避免了在多任務學習等設置中單獨校準組件的乘法開銷。
